verdict.rationale: The IRS has real machine channels for a narrow slice of its services: Modernized e-File (XML system-to-system filing) and IRIS A2A for information returns. Both require credentialing as an authorized e-file provider or Transmitter Control Code holder, including up to 45 days of approval and fingerprinting for some principals. UI services have no API equivalent: the EIN online assistant, Online Account functions behind ID.me biometric sign-in, and online signed forms such as the Form 15620 83(b) election. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and a 403 on the online 15620 flow. Missing for 10: API coverage of EIN issuance, Online Account/transcripts, payments and signed online forms; public (non-credentialed) API access; published API spec.
